info.title: Acme Commerce API
info.description: Everything you need to sell: customers, orders, refunds, the product catalogue and webhooks. REST over HTTPS, JSON in and out, bearer-token authenticated.

tags.name: Authentication (v2)
tags.description: Exchange an API key pair for a bearer token, and revoke it when you are done.

tags.name: Customers (v2)
tags.description: Create and manage the people who place orders.

tags.name: Webhooks (v2)
tags.description: Receive signed callbacks when things happen in your account.

tags.name: Authentication (v1)
tags.description: Unchanged in v2 apart from the path.

tags.name: Customers (v1)
tags.description: Reading and creating customers. Updating and deleting them arrived in v2.

tags.name: Orders (v1)
tags.description: Placing and reading orders. Refunds arrived in v2.

tags.name: Products (v1)
tags.description: The public product catalogue, with the search route v2 replaced.

post.description: Exchanges an API key pair for a short-lived bearer token. Tokens expire after one hour; request a new one rather than caching indefinitely.

key_id.description: The public half of your API key pair.

key_secret.description: The secret half. Never send this from a browser.

scopes.description: Defaults to every scope the key is entitled to.

201.description: A token you can use as a bearer credential.

value.message: These credentials do not match our records.

delete.description: Invalidates the token used to make this call. Idempotent — revoking an already-revoked token still returns 204.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of customers, newest first. Use `status` to narrow the list, and `q` to search across name and email.

post.description: Creates a customer and, unless `send_invite` is false, emails them an invitation.

email.description: Must be unique across your account.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value pairs echoed back on reads.

value.message: The email has already been taken.

email: The email has already been taken.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Embed a related collection in the response.

parameters.name: customer_id
parameters.description: Only orders belonging to this customer.

post.description: Creates an order in `pending` state. A retried request creates a second order; v2 accepts an `Idempotency-Key` header that makes the retry safe.

429.description: Too many orders created. Back off and retry after the interval in the Retry-After header.

get.description: Public catalogue. No credentials required, so this endpoint is safe to call from a browser.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Prices are converted to this currency.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search over name and description. Replaces the v1 search endpoint.

get.description: Removed in v2, where the list endpoint takes a `q` parameter instead. Kept here for integrations that have not moved yet.

patch.description: Partial update — omitted fields are left untouched.

status.description: Archiving hides the customer from list endpoints.

delete.description: Permanently removes the customer and anonymises their orders. Prefer archiving via the update endpoint.

409.description: The customer has an open order and cannot be deleted.

post.description: Creates an order in `pending` state. Send the `Idempotency-Key` header so a retried request cannot double-charge.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per logical order. Replays return the original order.

429.description: Too many orders created. Back off and retry after the interval in the Retry-After header.

post.description: Refunds all or part of a paid order. Partial refunds may be issued repeatedly up to the order total.

amount.description: Minor units. Omit to refund the full remaining balance.

409.description: The order is not in a refundable state.

post.description: We POST a signed JSON payload to your URL for each subscribed event. Verify the `X-Acme-Signature` header before trusting a delivery.
